# NewtonSceneAPI (fallbacks read by the PhysX parser)

Newton scene settings the [PhysX](glossary.md#physx) parser reads as fallbacks on every PhysicsScene: the step rate when physxScene:timeStepsPerSecond is absent, and a switch that turns gravity off.

- **Applies to:** `PhysicsScene`
- **No [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns) gate:** the consumer reads these columns whenever they exist on the [prim](glossary.md#prim), applied or not. Listing the API is still what the producer does and what the builders write.

## What USD population writes

Published like any applied API when the Newton schema is registered for population; without the registration its attributes are lost (see the [ovphysx](glossary.md#ovphysx) Newton schema notes).

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the [USD](glossary.md#usd) schema value. *Producer writes* is what [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `newton:timeStepsPerSecond` | int32 | 1/s | 1000 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 60 **diverges** | The scene keeps physxScene:timeStepsPerSecond, else 60. Consulted only when physxScene:timeStepsPerSecond is absent; values are clamped to [1, UINT_MAX]. |
| `newton:gravityEnabled` | bool8 | none | true | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | true | Gravity as configured. A present false zeroes the gravity magnitude, whatever physics:gravityMagnitude says. |

## Notes

- newton:gravityEnabled (NewtonSceneAPI family, read on this prim by attribute name, no schema gate): when the column is present and false, physics:gravityMagnitude is forced to 0. Unconditional: an authored physics:gravityMagnitude does not suppress it, and on ovstage presence of the column is the whole gate because every column reads as authored. Absent: gravity applies.
- newton:timeStepsPerSecond: fallback for physxScene:timeStepsPerSecond, applied only when the PhysX column is absent or out of range (an in-range PhysX value wins). Clamped to [1, UINT_MAX]. On a producer-populated stage with PhysxSceneAPI applied the published 60 counts as authored, so the fallback is unreachable there.
- The parser reads these columns without checking that NewtonSceneAPI is listed in usd-schemas. The compiled cache reads them but does not support the API: a prim that lists NewtonSceneAPI makes the cache bypass.
